definition_used: Impurities were found or suspected within cell lines or tissues.
semantic_rationale: Contamination directly compromises the reliability of research materials, fitting research_content_reliability. The definition describes impurities in cell lines/tissues, which are core methodological components, so problem_object is methods_materials. The process_signal is journal_publisher_investigation as a default for such findings, though the definition does not specify the investigation source; actor_context is unclear. No other categories are supported.
